newsitem.title: DENMARK: Rapeseed fuel faces price challenge - Danish study.
newsitem.headline: Rapeseed fuel faces price challenge - Danish study.

text.p: Fuel derived from rapeseed oil compares well with diesel in terms of performance and pollution, but its price is prohibitive, a study by the Danish Technological Institute (DTI) says .

DTI engineer Ken Friis Hansen told Reuters on Friday that rapeseed fuel, known as RME, produces higher levels of emissions than ultra-light diesel but they are biodegradable and less harmful overall to human health.
"The drawback for now is price. Using current production techniques it would cost six crowns to produce a litre of RME compared to one crown per litre of diesel," he said.
